Coroutines and Tasks¶

This section outlines the high-level asyncio APIs to work with coroutines and Tasks.

Running Tasks Concurrently¶

Awaitables can be wrapped into Tasks and scheduled to run concurrently.

await asyncio.gather(*aws,
                       return_exceptions=False)

asyncio.gather¶

If any awaitable in aws is a coroutine, it is automatically scheduled as a Task.

If return_exceptions is False, the first raised exception is immediately propagated to the task that awaits on gather. The other awaitables in the aws sequence are not cancelled and continue to run.

If return_exceptions is True, exceptions are treated the same as successful results and aggregated in the result list instead of being raised here.

exception asyncio.CancelledError
Raised when the awaited task is cancelled by the event loop.
  • Tasks support cancellation and introspection through the Task object.
